Actual Article Body:
NASHVILLE, Tenn. (WSMV) - Be prepared for impacts to your Wednesday morning commute.

FIRST ALERT WEATHER DAY - WEDNESDAY

Another drenching rain is coming to Middle Tennessee and Southern Kentucky as a strong cold front passes through the Midstate.

Widespread rain, along with some rumbles of thunder, will move in late Tuesday night and through our Wednesday morning.

Rain will be heavy at times causing poor visibility, road ponding and the risk of hydroplaning. Training heavy downpours could cause flooding in low lying, poor drainage areas.

At this time, we are not expecting any severe weather for the Midstate.

1-2″ of rain will fall across most of the Midstate Tuesday through Wednesday, with some isolated locations receiving over 2″.

Rain will taper off quickly on Wednesday evening. Highs Wednesday will stay in the low 70s.
